main_text.p: suffragia colligenda,vt & præsentem moderetur, & si visum fuerit,proxime futurum conuocet.Act.1.16. Act.6.2.Act.15.13.14.
main_text.head: Atq; hæc de plurium ecclesiarum presbyterio.
main_text.p: Synodus,est presbyterion ex presbyterijs plurium in vna prouincia ecclesiarum,conflatum. Act.15.2.2. Cor.8.19.23.Zach.7.3.4.
Quod etiam maioribus & minoribus distingui potest,pro certo ecclesiarum numero : prout ad ecclesiarum leuamen constitutum fuerit.

Vniuersale concilium,est πρεσβυτέριον,ex multarum synodorum deligatis conflatum: ad ea statuenda & componenda,quæ vniuersæ ecclesiæ vel parti maximæ commoda futura fuerint. Act.15.2.6. 2. Chro.30.4.23. 1.Cor.8.19.23.Zach,7.3.4.
main_text.head: Atq; hæc de presbyteris, eorumq; muneribus compositis & simplicibus.
Sequitur de Thesauri diuini οἰκονόμοις.
main_text.p: Sunt autem,qui presbyteris adiuncti sunt: vt eos adiuuent thesaurum colligendo, & ad vsus prædictos distribuendo,rouiusq; populi curam agendo. 1. Chro.26.24 Act.6.1.2.3.4.Rom.12.6.
Fides vt agant omnia iuste, & sine fraude. Ibid.
Simplicitas,vt agant omnia(præcipuè distribuendo)prout causa & necessitas postulauerit.Ibid.

page.notes: The left-hand page (fragments of text at the left edge) is not transcribed. Brace structures are rendered as lines with the braces' content kept in order. The reference "Act.15.2.6. 2." and similar are printed as given. Greek words are transcribed as read; the Greek in "πρεσβυτέριον" and "οἰκονόμοις" is approximate.
